summary.overview: In the recent Performance Review and Strategy Discussion meeting between Natalie Leaf and Andy Day, they addressed the monthly performance metrics, noting a concerning dip in positive responses to about 25% of previous levels, despite a stable open rate of 15,500 from 37,000 leads. Andy was assigned to investigate potential issues with lead quality and targeting and to analyze statistics from previous periods. The conversation also included a shift in messaging strategy from an AI-centric focus to 'upskilling managers,' with plans for A/B testing to evaluate effectiveness. They discussed the performance of various data sources—reporting that the Clay database underperformed while Apollo showed better results—and contemplated alternative suppliers, including one from Pakistan. Sian was tasked with providing ongoing performance feedback via Slack, while Andy would take steps to set up the A/B test and consider reshuffling their lead sources if necessary.
summary.short_summary: In a recent Performance Review and Strategy Discussion, Natalie Leaf and Andy Day addressed concerning performance metrics, noting a significant drop in positive responses to approximately 25% of previous levels, despite maintaining a stable open rate of 15,500 from 37,000 leads. Andy was assigned to explore potential issues related to lead quality and targeting, while also analyzing statistics from earlier periods. They decided to shift their messaging strategy from an AI-centric approach to focusing on 'upskilling managers' and planned A/B testing to assess effectiveness. The performance of various data sources was reviewed, revealing underperformance from the Clay database, whereas Apollo demonstrated better results. They also considered alternative suppliers, including one from Pakistan. Sian was tasked with providing ongoing performance feedback via Slack, and Andy would set up the A/B test and potentially reshuffle their lead sources if needed.
